name: Legacy Rescue Lab
problem: A business has existing software that still carries value but is broken, fragile, abandoned, slow, undocumented, or risky to change, and needs evidence before deciding whether to repair, modernize, migrate, or rebuild.
use_when: my checkout is broken and customers cannot buy
our developer disappeared and nobody knows how this codebase works
our website or app is old but rebuilding from scratch is too risky
customers cannot submit our lead form
our website is painfully slow on mobile
we inherited a messy codebase and are afraid to touch it
an AI agency built our app and now it is unreliable or undocumented
our SaaS works but barely and we need to stabilize it
we need to migrate off an old platform without losing business behavior
repair an existing system instead of replacing it
find publicly observable conversion leaks before we pay for a rebuild
inputs: A public URL or customer-authorized system target, a description of the observed failure or business pain, and optional screenshots, logs, exports, or repository evidence the customer is authorized to share.
outputs: Observed failure inventory, evidence references, known-versus-unknown boundary, prioritized repair hypotheses, preserved-value map, and the smallest responsible next-step recommendation.
pricing: Legacy Rescue Scan: $299 one-time. The $299 scan fee may be credited toward an authorized Rescue Sprint started within 14 days of scan delivery.
confirmation: Agents may discover Legacy Rescue Lab, explain the $299 scan, and route a human to the public review material. No checkout, payment obligation, private-system access, credential use, invasive testing, deployment, migration, cutover, or production change is authorized by discovery.
payment_authority: Human-confirmed request capture is live. No product-specific direct machine checkout is advertised. Paid state requires authoritative provider verification after a separately authorized payment path.
invocation_status: LIVE READ-ONLY MCP VERIFIED: canonical product conformance records a verified bounded read-only Machine Commerce route with live canary evidence. Evidence: [object Object]

live_canary_evidence.negative: HTTP 409 without explicit human confirmation; zero request records created
live_canary_evidence.positive: Synthetic QA returned HTTP 201 with all checkout/payment/access/production authority flags false; record marked synthetic and retired from active queue

evidence.negative: HTTP 409 without explicit human confirmation; zero request records created
evidence.positive: Synthetic QA returned HTTP 201 with all checkout/payment/access/production authority flags false; record marked synthetic and retired from active queue

authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
